findings.description: The KMS key used to encrypt the audit trail bucket does not set enable_key_rotation = true, so automatic annual rotation of the key material is disabled by default. Long-lived key material increases exposure if the key is ever compromised and weakens cryptographic hygiene for audit log data.

No explicit key policy is attached, so AWS applies the default policy granting the entire account root (and thus any IAM principal with KMS permissions in the account) full control over the key. For a key protecting audit trail data this means least-privilege access control is not enforced and audit logs could be decrypted or the key deleted by overly broad principals.
